_meta: Why ONRC applications are rejected: reasons from BERC rejection decisions, compared with postponement reasons. Aggregates only; no identifiers. Built by independent_audit/rejection_reasons/07_results.py. AI-assisted analysis (see README).

findings.window: rejection decisions 19 Oct-18 Nov 2026 (21 decision days with collected BERC bulletins)
findings.method: Full rejection decisions ("ÎNCHEIERE ... urmează a respinge prezenta cerere, pe motiv ... DISPUNE Respinge") parsed with PyMuPDF from all 545 bulletins; deduplicated on request nr + decision day; 100% linked to the archive Respins decision; type from the bulletin index section.
findings.caveat: Denominators are archive counts (sol == Respins, deduplicated on request nr + day).

findings.window: archive decisions 19 Oct-18 Nov 2026
findings.method: Archive counts: Respins, Renunțat (applicant waived, a separate outcome, not a rejection), AUTO_AMANARI, Admis.
findings.caveat: Archive misses some postponements on a few days.

findings.window: all archive rejections 19 Oct-18 Nov 2026 (census)
findings.method: Share of archive rejections with an earlier AUTO_AMANARI decision of the same request (same request nr and filing day). Median days last postponement -> rejection 16.0; filing -> rejection 51.0.
findings.caveat: Binomial CI; lower bound because the archive misses some postponements.

findings.window: all archive rejections 19 Oct-18 Nov 2026 (census)

findings.window: postponements decided 2026-09-01..2026-10-15, follow-up to 2026-11-20 17:21:10
findings.method: First later non-postponement decision of the same request (request nr + filing day) after its last postponement in the window.
findings.caveat: Unresolved requests at archive end are excluded from "of resolved".

findings.window: rejection decisions 19 Oct-18 Nov 2026 (21 decision days with collected BERC bulletins)
findings.method: Share of parsed rejections where the text states the postponement was not (or only partly) complied with (M_NEREMEDIAT + M_PARTIAL); regex on the procedural layer (step 2). Mechanism accuracy on the manual sample 0.927 (binary after-postponement 0.953).
findings.caveat: PDFs cover only the collected bulletins (~11% of archive rejections in the window); CIs reflect sampling among collected bulletins only; one rejection can cite several categories (shares sum to >100%); registrations have small n (wide CIs). Text-based "direct" rejections mostly do have an archived prior postponement (see RR.archive_prior_postponement).
